description: Self-hosted illustrations of the current official flags of the 50 United States for STATEHUB decorative state identifiers.
conversion: 45 original Wikimedia Commons SVG illustrations validated for scripts, events and external embedded references, with nonvisual editor metadata removed. Five Commons-rendered 960px PNGs of the same verified SVG designs are used for VA, WA, WV, WI and WY because the original-file service was rate limited. All assets are decoded and re-encoded without cropping to 640px width as WebP, quality 90. Original aspect ratios are retained to the nearest output pixel.

entries.credit: This file was derived from: Seal of Virginia.svg Code of Virginia, Article 1. Symbols of Sovereignty. § 1-506. Flag of the Commonwealth. The flag of the Commonwealth shall be a deep blue field, with a circular white centre of the same material. Upon this circle shall be painted or embroidered, to show on both sides alike, the coat of arms of the Commonwealth, as described in § 1-500 for the obverse of the great seal of the Commonwealth; and there may be a white fringe on the outer edge, furthest from the flagstaff. This shall be known and respected as the flag of the Commonwealth.
